title: The Blackthorn Crown
rumor: The Blackthorn Crown. A ruined watchpost somewhere in the forest bears carvings of a crown fashioned from twisted thorns. No one knows whether the symbol belongs to a forgotten kingdom, an ancient religious order, or something older. Travelers report that blackthorn bushes bloom around the ruins even in winter, and that their flowers never wither.
first_lead: A damaged survey sketch in the Forest Office depicts the watchpost.
